Fixed to a bare assignment (verified exit 2 honored) + corrected comment + test asserts the bare form and bans the swallowing pattern.

V2 (LOW/defense-in-depth, FIXED): gate-matrix did not constrain the id charset, and ids are interpolated into the CI shell matrix (--only, test path). A crafted id with quotes+metachars could inject. Fixed: gate-matrix rejects any id outside ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$, fail-closed; tests cover a metachar id, a space/uppercase id, and a normal kebab id (no false positive). Low because the manifest is provenance+parity frozen, but gate-matrix is the right place to enforce.
